# Profile source fixtures

Recorded once by hand on 2026-11-26 from each API (see the module docstrings under
`modules/profiles/` for the request), then cut down. Every person in them is invented: the
names, handles, emails, text, IDs and picture addresses were replaced, and the shape and the
field names are the API's own. The tests never use the network.

Launchpad and Gitea.com were recorded on 2026-11-27 in the same way. The Mastodon instances
other than mastodon.social answer in the tests with `mastodon_found.json`, its host replaced.
